title: driver plan manifest.json
description: Machine-readable plan at .plan/<ISSUE-ID>/manifest.json. The driver fans implement out over tasks[] in depends_on order; spec-audit verifies acceptance_criteria[].

depends_on.description: task ids that must be done first

files.description: globs of files this task may stage/commit — implement stages only these

qa.description: optional scoped QA command run by the per-task quality-gate when params.qa_scope="scoped" (e.g. only this task's test files). Omit when no meaningful scoped command exists — the per-task gate then records qa=skipped and the full state.qa.command runs at cycle scope. For a single-task manifest (when the cycle-scope gates run) the per-task gate is skipped entirely, so the scoped command then only matters for multi-task manifests

command.description: exact scoped command the task-scope quality-gate runs from the repo root

scope.description: "task" (default): verified in the scope=task spec-audit right after the owning task's commit. "cycle": integration-level criterion that only makes sense once all tasks are done — verified in the end-of-cycle scope=cycle audit, skipped in task scope
